title: Files added to a warm workspace
pins: A new file must be compiled and its diagnostics must appear, while the pre-existing files stay cached. Adding a clean file first, then a violating one, separates 'new file compiles' from 'new file's diagnostics reach the report'.
reuseNote: Adding a file changes the cross-module function map, whose hash is compared unconditionally (#823 review m1): every cached output may carry stale qualification, so the build invalidates globally. Zero reuse here is the compiler's designed behaviour, pinned so a change to it is visible.
